content.short: PieDAO is a DeFi-centered decentralized autonomous organization.
content.description: PieDAO is an on-chain community of DeFi builders across multiple blockchain ecosystems, including Ethereum and other networks. One of the DAO’s most popular products is Pie Smart Pools, an open-source automated market maker. The PieDAO vault provides a secure on-chain place to store and manage communal assets. PieDAO does not maintain a single self-hosted front end; members host their own front ends, and end users connect through any member’s interface.
